summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Aivora MVP. 40/40 pytest backend cases passed covering auth (register/login/me/onboard), personas (profile+1 portrait+duplicate+soft-delete), SSE chat streaming, memory CRUD, multi-agent orchestration (end-to-end polling to completed with final_output), reminders (create/list/incoming/decline/delete), wallet (get/packages/topup/404), admin RBAC (overview/users/tasks/pricing + 403 for normal users). Frontend E2E 10/10 steps passed: register -> onboarding -> home shows 500 credits -> wallet packages (5) -> simulated top-up starter +500 -> language toggle ID/EN -> reminder create -> chat/workspace pages load -> nav-admin hidden for normal user, visible+working for admin with 4 tabs rendering.

minor.issue: Each ringing item fetches persona via db.personas.find_one WITHOUT the {_id:0} projection -- the raw dict is attached to it['persona'] only after projecting fields, so this is fine for serialization (only name+portrait are copied), but keeps _id in memory. Non-blocking.
Could not test the LLM-generated accept path without a scheduler-ringing reminder; decline path confirmed. Low risk — flow mirrors chat generation already covered.

issues: Package card 'Beli' button is readable; 'Best Value' badge contrast on the Plus card is good. No contrast issues detected on inspected screens.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') -- FastAPI recommends lifespan context manager. Non-blocking but should migrate.

chat.py StreamingResponse never records usage/persists assistant message if the client disconnects mid-stream (generator aborts). Consider wrapping persistence in try/finally or doing the LLM call + DB write first then stream from captured text (currently it DOES call llm_text first, then streams, then writes -- so this is already safe; verified).
agents._orchestrate retries llm_text once on empty output but swallows all exceptions silently; errors not surfaced to the task record unless the outer try fails. Consider logging per-step errors.

personas.generate_profile does not validate the LLM-returned JSON schema -- malformed JSON would fall through llm_json but a missing nested key could break downstream portrait generation. Add light schema validation.
wallet.wallet() recomputes consumed/breakdown by scanning up to 2000 usage_events on every GET; fine for MVP but add an aggregation/index on user_id for scale.
reminders.scheduler_tick() has a race: it marks 'scheduled' -> 'ringing' individually; under concurrent server instances this could double-ring. OK for single-pod MVP.
No rate limiting on /api/personas/{id}/portrait (expensive image call) or /api/tasks (long LLM orchestration). Add per-user cooldown or credit pre-check.
JWT_SECRET value in backend/.env has a weak sentinel ('aivora-dev-secret-change-in-prod-...'). Must be rotated for production.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is permissive; browsers will ignore credentials with wildcard but tighten before prod.
test_credentials: admin@aivora.ai / Aivora!Admin2026 (seeded, verified). Fresh test users created per run via /api/auth/register (auto-verified, 500 credits).
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates one TEST_user_<hex>@aivora.ai account, one persona (+ portrait, + duplicate soft-deleted), one conversation (deleted at end), one multi-agent task (deleted at end), one reminder (deleted at end), and performs one simulated top-up. Admin counters will reflect the persona/user accretion over runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini has `-n 2 --dist loadscope` from xdist. backend_test.py uses a module-level `state` dict shared across classes -- MUST run with `-n 0` to disable xdist (classes land on different workers under loadscope and lose state). Command used: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Image generation call via Gemini costs ~25 credits + ~15-20s; keep at one call per run. Multi-agent task completes in ~30-45s. Admin login uses credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
rca of the issue: No bugs reproduced; app is in working state end-to-end.
